departments.name: Department of Computer Applications (BCA / MCA)
departments.description: The Department of Computer Applications offers premier undergraduate (BCA) and postgraduate (MCA - AICTE Approved) education emphasizing software engineering, AI, web architecture, and cloud paradigms.
departments.vision: To be a center of excellence in computer applications education, empowering students with state-of-the-art technological acumen, moral values, and global competencies.
departments.mission: To impart quality education through industry-aligned curriculum, experiential laboratory learning, research exposure, and value-based professional ethics.
departments.history: Established to cater to the booming IT revolution, the department has grown into a prestigious hub offering modern computer laboratories, IoT testbeds, and consistent university distinctions.

Dedicated Cloud & IoT Embedded Systems Research Lab
High-Speed 1 Gbps Campus Fiber Internet Backbone

departments.name: Department of Physics

departments.mission: To provide comprehensive pedagogical and experimental training in modern physics, cultivating analytical inquiry and scientific ethics.

departments.name: Department of Chemistry

programmes.title: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
programmes.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / PUC (Pre-University Course) or equivalent examination in any stream (Science / Commerce / Arts) with minimum 45% aggregate marks.
programmes.overview: The Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) is a premier autonomous undergraduate programme designed to prepare students for lucrative careers in software development, cloud computing, AI applications, full-stack engineering, and cybersecurity.
programmes.history: Established as an autonomous flagship programme, BCA at St. Philomena's is renowned for state-of-the-art computing laboratories, annual Techno Expo events, and top multinational corporate placements.
programmes.vision: To be a premier center of computer applications education empowering students with cutting-edge software acumen, moral values, and global competitiveness.
programmes.mission: To impart quality computational pedagogy through experiential laboratory sessions, industry-aligned curriculum, research workshops, and holistic professional ethics.
achievements: Consistent university top rankings and distinction percentages.
Over 90% placement record in leading IT multinationals including Infosys, Wipro, TCS, Cognizant, and IBM.
Host of the acclaimed annual national tech symposium Techno Expo.
curriculumHighlights: Data Structures, Algorithms & Advanced Java Frameworks
Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning with Python

programmes.title: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
programmes.eligibility: Passed BCA/Bachelor Degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent Degree. OR Passed B.Sc./ B.Com./ B.A. with Mathematics at 10+2 Level or at Graduation Level with at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/Category-I). Qualifying entrance rank in PGCET / KMAT required for government merit seats.

programmes.mission: To deliver rigorous advanced computational education, fostering research mindset, enterprise software architecture skills, and ethical leadership.

High-package corporate placements in tier-1 product companies and enterprise solution providers.
Mandatory final-semester live industry internships and research publications.

Deep Learning, Computer Vision & Natural Language Processing
Big Data Analytics, Distributed Systems & Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure)
Advanced Mobile Application Development & Blockchain Technology
